scope: Keep Bluetooth and other symbolic icons visible when their names overlap application artwork in generated overlays.
approval: The maintainer explicitly approved the light and dark before-and-after previews shown for PR #161.

checks.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_icon_toolset.py -k 'overlay or installer_selector' (4 passed)

coverage_limits: The PR author provided mask-rendered comparisons and live icon lookups in Plasma 6.7.4 Regular. The merged icon assets, generator and Bluetooth rendering sources match the reviewed PR. Focused local checks exercised generated overlays and reserved symbols.
